paper_title: Projected sensitivities of the LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) experiment to new physics via low-energy electron recoils
notes: Projection paper. Multiple couplings studied. Best-defined AxionElectron result quoted numerically is the galactic ALP dark-matter search: 90% CL exclusion of g_Ae up to ~7.6e-14 at ~64.3 keV (2-70 keV scan). Only a single numeric point is given in the text; full exclusion curve is in Fig. 4d (not tabulated). A separate solar-axion analysis also constrains g_Ae down to 1.58e-12 (mass-independent, NOT a DM search, no density). Hidden-photon (DarkPhoton) kinetic mixing kappa^2 ~7.4e-28 at 64.3 keV also reported.
